implemented: Extend existing forced-GMAC cancellation fixture through managed public bootstrap, both original bound channels and one replacement.
Move ordinary ECHO traffic to another channel before cancelling a pending watch; replace that non-owner while STATUS_PENDING is held before publication.
Track every notification/CANCEL by physical Connection and actual bound key, including retired channel keys; independently verify nonce/tag with default JCE.
Require exactly one CANCEL under eight competing callers, correct sync/async identity, final retirement, successful later notifications and lowest ordinary per-connection MID consumption.
Reuse existing isolated Java8 profile for this same native suite without changing the production JAR.
